digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler — outbound parent field emission
propositions: A non-epic parent that cannot be represented on DC returns from _resolve_local_parent indistinguishable from 'unbound, retry later', preventing bridge_alerts from firing and leaving the hierarchy divergence silent while the pass exits 0.

Three live test cells fail because they assert operations the platform cannot perform (sub-task reparent accept-and-ignore, sub-task parent clear 400); re-homing to Epic Link mechanism (which already works) preserves user-visible contracts while pinning the platform limit separately.

The emit-time suppression of non-epic parent writes must produce a durable operator-visible record (outbound-field-dropped alert) when the suppressed parent diverges from the tracker, not a silent return from _resolve_local_parent.

Re-homed inbound test starts parentless to avoid outbound re-assertion undoing the instance-side move; Epic Link clear with local rebar priming ensures the ref is managed before propagation logic runs.
